purpose: Public-source research layer for mapping intelligence, security, law-enforcement and military organizations as institutions, information systems, jurisdictions, oversight structures, historical controversies and documented cases. This is an analytical map, not an operational guide.
epistemic_rule: Distinguish official institutional claims, declassified records, court records, commissions, journalism, academic research and allegations. A reported allegation is not a finding of fact.

network_model.data_flow_template: source -> collection -> processing -> database -> query -> analysis -> dissemination -> decision -> oversight -> archive/release

historical_controversy_and_case_schema.rule: For killings, never encode an intelligence service or person as responsible merely because a source alleges it. Store allegation, attribution evidence, official denial and later findings as separate fields.

research_next.geographic_next: Map headquarters, legal jurisdiction, public facilities and historical operational regions only where reliably documented; do not infer secret facilities or current operational locations from weak sources.
